[John Garnaut](http://www.smh.com.au/news/business/deputy-dogfight-in-the-rba-corral/2006/08/25/1156012739762.html?page=fullpage#contentSwap2 "John Garnaut"), on the RBA’s not so distant past:

> *Back then \[1989\], the Reserve Bank was a crusty old institution in desperate need of reinvention and it still hated the idea of being run by an outsider.*

[Some](http://www.cis.org.au/policy/spring04/spring04-9.pdf "Some") would argue that not a whole lot has changed.
